The Ritual

How to wear it

Three quiet minutes, twice a week. AURÉLLA's gel-effect formula is designed to be applied slowly and worn long.

01

Prepare

Begin with clean, dry nails. Push back the cuticle, shape to a long, elegant almond, and wipe each nail with remover to lift away natural oils.

02

Colour

Float two thin coats of lacquer from cuticle to tip, sealing the free edge with the second pass. Thin coats dry faster — and last longer.

03

Seal

Finish with a glass top coat for the mirror shine. Refresh it on day four and the colour carries through a full ten days.

The Atelier

Colour, treated like couture

AURÉLLA began with a single question: why should a nail lacquer feel any less considered than a lipstick or a scent? Each shade is pigment-milled for depth, bottled in weighted glass, and capped by hand. No noise, no seasons chasing trends — six colours, perfected.
